cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm taking our extension proposal to the neighbors. Sign your support here so they can see I'm not speaking alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like the extension. I don't want my full name on the page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll keep it discreet. What mark would you be comfortable putting beside your support?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Initials it is. I'll use the same size. Could we put the household names in a small key below? You choose where; I need them to know which support is yours when the objections start.

relationship.evidence: B2 likes the project but values limited exposure; B4 specifies the compromise clearly.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts a discreet mark yet tries to restore its traceability through a small key.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 small key neatly reveals why apparent discretion does not satisfy A without identity.
